sentences.text: Florida leads the nation in lightning, and summer thunderstorms are a near-daily hazard.
They usually build over land in the early afternoon and drift toward the coast.
Gusts flowing out of a storm can hit well before the rain, sometimes at gale force.
If you hear thunder, you’re within striking distance, so head in early.
If you’re caught out, get everyone low, away from metal, rods and the console, and out of the water.
Waterspouts are common in the Keys and along both coasts.
Most are fair-weather spouts, but treat every one as dangerous and move away at right angles to its path.
